title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site update
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, two tool-calling quickstarts (Python and TypeScript), and updates to the docs site to surface the new examples and how-to guides. Motivation: provide customers and internal teams with vetted, production-oriented starter templates for building agents that combine retrieval, tool-calling, and Redwood's streaming/structured output features. Changes include: 1) redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates: three opinionated agent templates (faq-bot, multi-doc-synthesizer, workflow-runner) with README and minimal integration tests. 2) redwood-examples/quickstarts/tool-calling-python and tool-calling-typescript: step-by-step quickstarts demonstrating tool registration, tool schemas, function/tool calling, and structured output parsing. 3) redwood-docs/docs/guides/agents: new guide pages linking to the quickstarts and templates, troubleshooting tips, and recommended prompt/serialization patterns. 4) docs site navigation and examples index updates to surface the new content. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and quickstarts - [x] Docs pages and sidebar updates - [x] Unit/integration smoke tests for examples - [x] CI green after flaky test rerun - [x] Documentation review and copyedit Notes on testing: examples include small integration checks that run against mock tool endpoints and a local SQLite retrieval index (fast to run in CI). CI initially failed a flaky network test; reran only the examples job which passed. Backwards compatibility: templates are additive and configurable; no changes to existing public SDK surface. Related work: ENG-4821 (RAG templates initiative), DOCS-301 (examples site redesign).

release_notes: - Added three RAG agent templates (faq-bot, multi-doc-synthesizer, workflow-runner) to redwood-examples. - Added tool-calling quickstarts in Python and TypeScript demonstrating tool schemas and structured outputs. - New docs pages and sidebar entries under Guides → Agents linking to templates and quickstarts. - Examples include lightweight smoke tests and guidance for running locally.
notes: This PR is additive and intended to accelerate customer onboarding for RAG+agent workflows. Template configs include knobs for batching, retrieval window size, and cache TTL to make them suitable for both hosted and private deployments.
